description: Current status of a design job (used by the Yarda widget).
name: poll_job

approval_status.description: When review_required: the review's true state. Only the user's own approval changes awaiting_approval

brief.description: When review_required: the design brief frozen with the review

checkout_tool.description: When payment is required: the tool that returns a checkout link (subscribe)

in_chat_approval.description: When review_required: true = the user approves with the Generate button in the Yarda card shown with this result

next_step.description: When review_required: what to do next

preview_status.description: When review_required: whether the property preview (image, outline, brief) is shown with this result

review_expires_at.description: When review_required: when the review link stops working (ISO 8601)

review_id.description: When review_required: send it back to design_yard unchanged after the user confirms

review_revision.description: When review_required: the revision to send back with review_id

review_state.description: When review_required: preparing = wait and retry; ready = waiting on the user; confirmed = start the design

review_url.description: When review_required and in-chat approval is unavailable: the secure page where the user approves the property outline

status.description: succeeded = design ready; queued/running = keep polling; payment_required = stop generation and ask whether the user wants payment options; call checkout_tool only after an explicit user request, never automatically; temporary rate or service limits are not payment-required; review_required = the user must approve the property preview before the design starts (nothing charged): with the Generate button in the Yarda card when in_chat_approval is true, otherwise on the secure review page (review_url)

studio_url.description: Where the user can edit or refine this design in Yarda's web app (finished design, saved designs, the review's outline editor or Design Studio). Opening it never approves, starts or charges a design

title: Poll Design Job
